title: Enchantments
wikitext:
[[Category:Enchantment]]
Occasionally, when a piece of equipment is obtained, it will have a bonus effect on it, listing text next to its name and providing extra stats.

Although rare, equipment can have multiple enchants on them, up to 3 per piece.

Equipment with two enchants are called 'double enchants' and for three enchants, 'triple enchants'.

There are 250 unique double enchants and 1710 unique triple enchants if order is ignored.

190 unique double enchants are possible from any source of enchants, 60 additionally possible with thirsty, corroded and sweet.

1140 unique triple enchants are possible from any source of enchants, 570 additionally possible with thirsty, corroded and sweet.

Enchanted items are obtained by the same method you get the item normally, such as buying, crafting, or as a drop from an enemy.

Certain enchantments can only be obtained from a specific type of modified enemy, or specific dungeon:
* Corrupt - from corrupt enemies, indicated by glowing purple particles, only possible in the overworld.
* Legendary - from legendary enemies, indicated by glowing yellow particles, only possible in the overworld.
* Thirsty - from bloody enemies, indicated by glowing red particles, only possible in the overworld during a blood moon event.
* Corroded - from the Lord Frogg dungeon rewards at the end of the dungeon.
* Sweet - from the Queen Bumblz Hive dungeon rewards at the end of the dungeon.

Legendary and Corrupt enchants cannot be in a double or triple enchant, but the other exclusive enchants can be.



Additionally, enchants can also be obtained by using a [[Cleansing Tear]] while having equipment with the Corrupt enchant equipped, this method has an increased chance to yield an item with multiple enchants on it.

Enchants can be upgraded for 1 [[Brilliant Gem]] by talking to [[Brokkr]], with ascended enchants providing different effects. Trying to upgrade an ascended enchant will return it back to its default form.

==Enchant Transferring==
You can transfer enchants from one item to another through the enchant transfer machine in [[Magus]], found near [[Lapis]].

To use, select an ''unenchanted'' item you want to put the enchant on, and then select an item with the enchant you want to transfer. Then press the confirm button to transfer the enchant. Single-enchants will have a fee of 2000 V$.

Double or triple enchants will instead cost 5000 V$ and a [[Refined Core]] with a 33% chance of successful transfer. If the transfer fails, it will only consume the Voxos and the refined core without transferring the enchant. The transfer is guaranteed to succeed on the 4th attempt.
